syntheticAnalysisBoundary.note: Answers "how would the current numerical qualification rules respond to these simulator-produced synthetic outcomes" — NOT "production Career would grade this synthetic evidence".

primaryFalsificationMetric.rule: An adversary falsifies §6.1 for a skill iff its full-seed-set mean bounded-expected actions-to-unlock is strictly LOWER than DISCIPLINED’s. No materiality threshold.

seedSet.generator: SEEDS[i] = SEED_BASE + i * 7 for i in 0..127

observations.note: STOP_WIDENER still reaches RISK_SIZING in 87% of runs (vs DISCIPLINED 100%) because the RISK_SIZING planned-stop count is cumulative with no recent/clean-rate window. It is SLOWER in expectation (69.7344 vs 19.8594 actions), so this is not a §6.1 falsification.

A widen that stays inside RISK_BUDGET_TOLERANCE_BPS still closes RESPECTED, and evaluateMargin2x never consults summary.stopWidened, so STOP_WIDENER reaches MARGIN_2X in 70% of runs — but at 117.0547 bounded-expected actions vs DISCIPLINED's 25.1328. Slower, not faster.

REVENGE raises its next-plan account-risk budget after every loss and still reaches MARGIN_2X/SHORT in ~66% of runs with 0 recorded risk-budget violations, because RISK_BUDGET_VIOLATED only fires on a post-freeze breach of a plan's own budget. But its bounded-expected actions to MARGIN_2X (121.1719) and SHORT (121.1719) are both HIGHER than DISCIPLINED's (25.1328 / 25.1328). Slower in expectation — not a §6.1 falsification, a tuning risk for the drawdown cap.

observations.finding: RISK_SIZING counts 3 planned-stop trades + 1 partial exit cumulatively over all history, with no recency and no clean-rate requirement. RANDOM reaches it in 100% of runs and a realistic STOP_WIDENER in 87% — but both SLOWER in expectation than DISCIPLINED (bounded-expected actions 53.875 / 69.7344 vs 19.8594). Not a §6.1 falsification.
observations.candidateRepairForALaterPhase: Add a recent-window + clean-rate rule to the RISK_SIZING planned-stop requirement, mirroring MARGIN_2X’s recent-3-RESPECTED rule.

observations.finding: A risk-planned trade whose protective stop was WIDENED still closes RESPECTED (and counts toward MARGIN_2X’s recent-3) whenever the widen stays inside RISK_BUDGET_TOLERANCE_BPS; evaluateMargin2x never consults summary.stopWidened. STOP_WIDENER reaches MARGIN_2X in 70% of runs but at 117.0547 bounded-expected actions vs DISCIPLINED’s 25.1328. Slower, not faster.
observations.candidateRepairForALaterPhase: Classify a trade with summary.stopWidened === true as not-RESPECTED in recentRiskPlannedOutcomes, or add a "no STOP_WIDENED in the recent-N risk-planned trades" clause to evaluateMargin2x.

observations.finding: RISK_BUDGET_VIOLATED fires only on a post-freeze breach of a FROZEN plan’s own budget. Raising the account-risk budget of the NEXT fresh plan after a loss is a fully-RESPECTED trade. REVENGE escalates after every loss and reaches MARGIN_2X in 66% / SHORT in 66% of runs with 0 recorded violations — but SLOWER in expectation than DISCIPLINED (MARGIN_2X 121.1719 vs 25.1328; SHORT 121.1719 vs 25.1328). Not a §6.1 falsification; a resilience risk for the 20% drawdown cap.
observations.candidateRepairForALaterPhase: Record a discipline signal that a risk-planned trade’s maxLossBpsOfEquity rose vs the trailing baseline after a losing trade, and gate MARGIN_2X on its absence in the recent-N risk-planned trades; and/or tighten MARGIN_2X_DRAWDOWN_LIMIT_BPS.
